name: cql_get_status
description: Report JVM/Language Server readiness, jar path and source, java version, workspace root, and the language server version string. The first call starts resolving Java and the language-server jar in the background (a first run may download the jar); until it is ready, `runtime.state` is `resolving` with the current `phase` and download progress.

name: cql_execute
description: Execute a single CQL library against the language server and return expression results. Compiler/runtime errors are returned as diagnostics with success=false (not a transport error). Provide contextValues to run one library request per patient/context value. For a file in the IG Publisher default layout (<root>/input/cql/*.cql with an ig.ini at <root> or above), rootDir, terminologyUri and optionsPath default to <root> and the default-layout paths <root>/input/vocabulary/valueset and <root>/input/cql/cql-options.json; explicit arguments override. Other files get no rootDir. Patient data is only read when modelUri is set. Output is bounded by maxChars: when the result is larger, trailing expression results are dropped and listed by name under omittedExpressions (with omittedCount), log lines that do not fit are counted in omittedLogLines, and the result has truncated: true, totalChars (the full serialized length) and maxChars. Diagnostics are always kept. Narrow the request (fewer contextValues) or raise maxChars to see the rest.

contextValues.description: Patient/context values; one library request is built per value

cqlFile.description: Path to the .cql file to execute

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of result to return (default 50000, minimum 1000).

modelName.description: Model identifier sent to the LS (defaults to "FHIR").

modelUri.description: Filesystem path to a directory of FHIR resources (IgStandardRepository root). When set, resources in that directory are loaded for retrieval; omit for compile-only runs.

optionsPath.description: Path to a cql-options file. Defaults to <IG root>/input/cql/cql-options.json.

rootDir.description: IG project root (where the LS finds ig.ini and loads IG packages). Defaults to the IG root of cqlFile; none outside an IG.

terminologyUri.description: Path to a terminology directory/file. Defaults to <IG root>/input/vocabulary/valueset.

name: cql_view_elm
description: Return the ELM representation of a CQL library as the language server serializes it. elmType is 'xml', 'json', or 'ast'. Output is bounded by maxChars, measured on the serialized JSON result (quotes in JSON ELM are escaped, so they count twice): when the result is longer, `content` is cut to a prefix that makes the whole result fit, and the result has truncated: true, totalChars (the full serialized length) and maxChars. Use a larger maxChars to see more.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of result to return (default 50000, minimum 1000).

name: cql_get_signatures
description: Extracts all expressions (defines), functions, parameters, value sets, and code systems from a CQL file along with their exact compiled return types and parameter types.

includePrivate.description: Whether to include private definitions and functions. Defaults to false.

name: cql_resolve_includes
description: Resolves included CQL libraries referenced by a CQL file, locating their source files on disk and extracting their public definitions, functions, and terminology bindings.

alias.description: Optional alias (localIdentifier) to resolve specifically (e.g. "Global" or "FHIRHelpers"). If omitted, all included libraries are resolved.

includeSignatures.description: Whether to parse and return public defines, functions, and value sets for each included library. Defaults to true.

name: cql_validate
description: Validates a CQL file or in-memory CQL content for syntax and type errors without executing patient bundles, returning compiler diagnostics and translation errors.

content.description: Optional in-memory CQL content to validate without saving to disk. Overrides file contents on disk.

quiescenceMs.description: Milliseconds of quiet time after receiving diagnostics before settling. Defaults to 100.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for compiler diagnostics. Defaults to 2000.

name: cql_debug_start
description: Start a DAP debug session for a CQL library. Chains LSP `startDebugSession` → TCP connect → DAP `initialize`/`launch`/`configurationDone` in a single call so the LS 10-second accept window is not missed. Optionally pass `breakpoints` to set them before launch (via the LS pre-launch breakpoints fallback), avoiding a separate cql_debug_set_breakpoints round-trip. Enforces a single active session: call cql_debug_stop first if one is already running. Pass cqlFile as the path to a .cql file (the tool internally computes both DAP-form and executeCql-form URIs). For a file in the IG Publisher default layout (<root>/input/cql/*.cql with an ig.ini at <root> or above), rootDir, terminologyUri and optionsPath default to <root> and the default-layout paths <root>/input/vocabulary/valueset and <root>/input/cql/cql-options.json (when they exist), as for cql_execute; explicit arguments override. Without rootDir an IG library fails to compile and the session terminates without stopping.

breakpoints.description: 1-indexed line numbers to set on cqlFile before launch

parameters.description: CQL parameter values: an array of { name, type, value } (preferred, as for cql_execute), or an object keyed by name

testCaseDir.description: Path to MADIE test-case bundle directory

name: cql_debug_set_breakpoints
description: Set breakpoints (line numbers) in a CQL file. Put each breakpoint on an expression line, not on the `define "X":` line: the LS only stops on expression and expression-term start lines (CqlStepPositionCollector.collectBreakpointableLines). The response may still say verified=true for other lines; the LS marks them unverified later (BreakpointManager.updateBreakpointLineVerification), and a resume that then terminates without stopping lists them in unverifiedBreakpoints.

name: cql_debug_continue
description: Resume execution; blocks until the debuggee stops, terminates, or the optional timeoutMs elapses. Timeout is NOT an error: the session stays alive and paused. When the debuggee terminates (or the language server goes away) the session ends by itself, so cql_debug_start can be called again without cql_debug_stop. If it terminates without ever stopping although breakpoints were set, the result has a note, unverifiedBreakpoints, and errors (Error entries from re-running the library with the launch settings); with no breakpoints set the note is "terminated (no breakpoints set)".

name: cql_debug_next
description: Step over the current statement. Same blocked-until-stop semantics, and same terminated result, as continue.

name: cql_debug_step_in
description: Step into the current call. Same blocked-until-stop semantics, and same terminated result, as continue.

name: cql_debug_step_out
description: Step out of the current function. Same blocked-until-stop semantics, and same terminated result, as continue.

name: cql_debug_get_variables
description: Fetch variables. If frameId is given, scopes are enumerated and each scope is expanded into its variable list (flattened one level). If variablesReference is given, only that subtree is fetched. Exactly one of frameId / variablesReference should be supplied. Output is bounded by maxChars: when there are more variables than fit, trailing variables are dropped and listed by name under omittedVariables (with omittedCount), and the result has truncated: true, totalChars (the full serialized length) and maxChars. Fetch a sub-tree with variablesReference or raise maxChars to see the rest.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of result to return (default 50000, minimum 1000).

name: cql_debug_evaluate
description: Evaluate a CQL expression in the current frame (frameId) or in a watch/hover context (no frameId). Returns the same shape DAP `evaluate` returns: result, type, variablesReference.

name: cql_debug_stop
description: Disconnect the active DAP session and close the TCP socket. A no-op if the session has already ended (the debuggee terminated or the language server went away).

name: cql_test_run_file
description: Run a single CQL file against one or more context values (one library request per value), persist the result, and update the latest/previous pointer for the suite. Returns the persisted RunRecord (counts + per-case results). Patient data is only read when modelUri is set (use cql_test_run_suite for test-case folders). For a cqlFile in the IG Publisher default layout (<root>/input/cql/*.cql with an ig.ini at <root> or above), rootDir, terminologyUri and optionsPath default to <root> and the default-layout paths <root>/input/vocabulary/valueset and <root>/input/cql/cql-options.json; explicit arguments override. Case status: passed = evaluated with no Error entries; failed = the language server returned Error entries (e.g. compile errors); errored = the language server crashed on this case; skipped = not run after a crash. Status is NOT a comparison against expected results (MeasureReport / TestCaseResult).

contextValues.description: Patient/context values to run against (one library request per value)

cqlFile.description: Path to the .cql file to execute

modelUri.description: Directory of FHIR resources (e.g. one test-case folder) to evaluate against.

suiteName.description: Logical suite name. Defaults to the CQL file stem. Used to group runs in listings and diffs.

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root under which .cql-debug/test-runs is stored. Defaults to MCP CWD.

name: cql_test_run_suite
description: Discover test cases under `<suiteRoot>/<suiteName>/<patient-uuid>/` (Layout A), merge per-case parameters from a config.jsonc file (with caller-supplied exclusions unioned in), run each case, persist the result, and update the latest/previous pointer. The `shared` directory is always excluded. Each case is evaluated against its own folder's FHIR resources. For a cqlFile in the IG Publisher default layout (<root>/input/cql/*.cql with an ig.ini at <root> or above), rootDir, terminologyUri and optionsPath default to <root> and the default-layout paths <root>/input/vocabulary/valueset and <root>/input/cql/cql-options.json; explicit arguments override. Case status: passed = evaluated with no Error entries; failed = the language server returned Error entries (e.g. compile errors); errored = the language server crashed on this case; skipped = not run after a crash. Status is NOT a comparison against expected results (MeasureReport / TestCaseResult).

configPath.description: Optional path to a .jsonc config file. Loads .jsonc preferentially over .json if both exist at the same path.

excludeTestCases.description: Test case (subdirectory) names to exclude; unioned with config.testCasesToExclude.

rootDir.description: IG project root. Defaults to the IG root of cqlFile.

suiteName.description: Suite (library) name — selects the subdirectory under suiteRoot.

suiteRoot.description: Parent directory containing one subdirectory per library/suite (Layout A: each subdirectory contains test-case dirs).

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root under which .cql-debug/test-runs is stored. Defaults to MCP CWD.

name: cql_test_list_runs
description: List previously persisted test runs (newest-first). Optionally filter by suite and limit the count.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return

suiteName.description: Suite (library) name. Filters to runs of this suite only.

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root under which .cql-debug/test-runs is stored. Defaults to MCP CWD.

name: cql_test_diff
description: Diff two persisted runs for the same suite. Either provide two hash-or-timestamp strings via runA/runB, or pass "latest"/"previous" to use the pointer files for the suite. If no previous run has been recorded, returns a no_previous_run status (not an error).

runA.description: Hash prefix (8+ chars) or timestamp (or timestamp prefix) of the first run, as listed by cql_test_list_runs (ISO form with ":" and "." also accepted, any case). Use "latest" or "previous" to use pointer files.

runB.description: Hash prefix (8+ chars) or timestamp (or timestamp prefix) of the second run, as listed by cql_test_list_runs (ISO form with ":" and "." also accepted, any case). Use "latest" or "previous" to use pointer files.

suiteName.description: Suite (library) name. Required. Suite whose runs should be diffed.

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root under which .cql-debug/test-runs is stored. Defaults to MCP CWD.
